purpose: Provenance for the two attention-sink reference codebases supplied by the research team. They are REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATIONS for A4/A5 only, never dependencies and never vendored. Any reused implementation must carry a comment naming repo, branch, commit SHA, and the original file/function.

scientific_firewall.statement: These repositories MUST NOT be used to select heads, layers, routes, or representations during A1-A3. Fact-route discovery stays blind to sink information.
scientific_firewall.enforced_by: freeze/fact_discovery_freeze.json must exist and hash-match before a4 may run

portability_warnings: GPT-2 query-bias (R_A = b_Q . k_0) has no Llama/RoPE analogue; do not rename it.
